title.en: Read is not done: separating notifications from tasks
title.zh: 已读不等于办完：通知与业务状态怎样分开

summary.en: Use an order reminder and a read-all race to explain separate state, deduplication and a query snapshot boundary.
summary.zh: 从订单提醒和“全部已读”的时间差出发，整理状态分离、重复提醒与查询快照的处理方法。

basis.en: Source observations and release documentation from Shuyang Home v1.6.0 (54ac363). The 41/42 sequence below is a teaching example, not a production event log.
basis.zh: 基于沭阳之家 v1.6.0（54ac363）源码和发布文档整理。下文序号 41 / 42 是用于推演的示例，不是实际用户事件记录。

title.zh: 两个状态，各自说明一件事

paragraphs.en: Opening a collection reminder tells the system that a member has seen a message. It says nothing about whether the goods were collected. The order completes through the original receive action, with its own permissions and transition rules.
paragraphs.zh: 打开一条自提提醒，只能说明会员看过消息，不能说明已经收到商品。订单完成应由原业务中的收货操作触发，并执行原有权限和状态检查。

paragraphs.en: The release separates notification read state from task completion. If the destination cannot be opened, it retains unread state; the member can still mark the message read explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 这一版本把通知已读和事项办结分开处理。目标详情无法打开时保留未读，用户也可以主动标记已读。两个操作表达不同意图，界面文字应写清楚。

title.en: A read-all action needs a time boundary
title.zh: “全部已读”需要一个明确边界

paragraphs.en: Suppose the visible inbox was fetched through sequence 41. Message 42 arrives before the user presses read all. Updating every unread row at click time would clear a message the user never saw.
paragraphs.zh: 假设列表查到的最大序号是 41。用户还没点“全部已读”，第 42 条消息已经到达。如果点击时直接清空所有未读，就会把用户没见过的消息一起清掉。

paragraphs.en: The documented operation sends the maximum sequence from the last query. That expresses which snapshot the user is acting on, while newer messages remain unread.
paragraphs.zh: 文档中的操作会提交上次查询的序号上限。这个参数说明用户在处理哪一批消息；超过该序号的新消息继续保持未读。

code.text:
visibleSnapshot.maxSequence = 41
newMessage.sequence = 42

markRead(recipient = currentUser, through = 41)
// Message 42 remains unread. Task state is unchanged.

title.en: Duplicate reminders have a business definition
title.zh: 判断重复，要看业务变化

paragraphs.en: BusinessNotifications builds a key from the recipient, business kind, object id, businessVersion and message. Repeating a save without a meaningful change should not create another reminder, while a later business version may require one.
paragraphs.zh: BusinessNotifications 使用接收人、业务类型、对象编号、businessVersion 和消息内容构成键。没有状态变化的重复保存不应再提醒；同一对象后续产生新的业务版本，则可能需要新消息。

paragraphs.en: Including message text in identity is a tradeoff: a wording change can affect identity too. If this grows into a distributed service, stable event ids and storage-level uniqueness would deserve a separate design and concurrency test. They are proposed extensions here.
paragraphs.zh: 把文案放进标识也有代价：修改措辞可能影响去重。如果以后扩展成分布式服务，我会单独设计稳定事件编号、数据库唯一约束和并发测试。这些是后续设计问题，不能从当前键拼接直接推导出“全局恰好一次”。

title.zh: 值得保留的四个检查场景

bullets.en: Open a reminder and verify that the underlying order is still waiting for the appropriate business action.
bullets.zh: 看完提醒后，检查订单仍等待对应业务操作，而不是自动完成。

bullets.en: Fetch through 41, insert 42, then mark the snapshot read. Only the earlier messages should change.
bullets.zh: 先查询到 41，再加入 42，最后按旧快照标记已读，检查新消息保持未读。

bullets.en: Repeat an unchanged operation, then make a genuine transition. Check both duplicate suppression and a new reminder.
bullets.zh: 先重复无变化操作，再执行一次有效状态迁移，同时检查去重和新通知产生。

bullets.en: Fail the business transaction and inspect whether a notice remains. The release documents shared rollback; verify it at the transaction boundary.
bullets.zh: 让业务事务失败，检查是否留下孤立通知。原版本记录了共同回滚，应在事务边界验证，而不只观察前端提示。

title.zh: 给前端开发的一点提醒

paragraphs.en: An unread badge is a view of notification state. A task badge is a view of business state. Keeping their refresh rules separate makes retries, multiple tabs and delayed responses easier to reason about.
paragraphs.zh: 未读角标来自通知状态，待办数量来自业务状态。把它们的刷新规则分开，重试、多标签页和旧响应等问题才容易定位。我会避免用同一个“已处理”字段同时承担两种含义。

label.zh: 快照、事务与交付范围文档
